suggested_change: Clarify: (1) Carry-forward scores should only be downgraded if new call data contradicts prior evidence; (2) 'No new information' calls must preserve prior score with explicit carry-forward note; (3) Evidence standard must be consistent across all components—either third-party descriptions count as evidence or they don't; (4) 'At Risk' health determination should depend only on objective call data, not on scoring contradictions.
